description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Working hours 

🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States. 

Preferred location:

  • USA 

 

Why this job is exciting

Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, our sellers and customer teams need to explain a fast-evolving product to a fast-moving market. Enablement is how we keep up.

This is the chance to lead Revenue Enablement and own its strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional alignment with Product, Marketing, and Revenue leadership. 

This is a player-coach role; like every role in the company we are do-ers as well as leaders. You'll set the direction and also build and deliver key programs yourself. You'll take topics from idea to finished program, pull in the right partners without being asked, and measure whether reps actually understood and applied what they learned, not just whether they completed it.

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Learn our products, our value prop, and our customer engagement process
  • Shadow every active enablement workstream, including our value framework roll-out, competitive trainings, product roadmap roll-out, onboarding programs for new hires, and more
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and across our Revenue teams (the key individuals you serve)
  • Work with your direct report to establish shared goals and responsibilities for how you’ll work together

📅 Within one quarter, you will…

  • Take ownership of the Revenue Enablement roadmap, intake, and prioritization process, with inputs from key stakeholders
  • Run key launches yourself, while also supporting your team’s workstreams as well
  • Report enablement progress to Revenue leadership on a regular cadence
  • Help us build out and execute on our FY28 Revenue Kick-Off

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Define how enablement measures comprehension and application, and report results to Revenue leadership
  • Coach your direct report to take programs from ideation to finished program on her own

 

About you 

You're an enablement practitioner first and a leader second. You can set a strategy on a Monday and run a live training on a Wednesday. You command a room, read it, and adjust in the moment, because you care whether teammates understood, not whether they finished.

You know how sales and enterprise GTM works. You understand processes and methodologies well enough to coach sellers and earn the trust of sales leaders. You've managed or led people and you enjoy developing someone early in their career.

Your skill-set:

  • 7+ years in revenue enablement, including experience at a developer tools company
  • Experience designing and delivering programs end-to-end: onboarding, methodology, persona, competitive, and launch training
  • Strong sales and business acumen, with a working knowledge of sales processes and methodologies
  • Excellent presentation and live facilitation skills
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Notion, and comparable tools

 

Level

📊 This job is an M3.  You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

 

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.

Your salary is determined by your pay band for the M3  job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.

💰 The target compensation for this role is $160,650 USD base + $28,350 USD variable ($189,000 USD on-target-earnings). 

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

 

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all! 

We expect the interview process to take 3.75 hours in total.

👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

  • 30-minute Recruiter Screen
  • 45-minute Hiring Manager Interview

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

  • 45-minute Team Interview with your future direct report
  • 30-minute X-Functional interview (PMM, Customer Success)

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

  • 45-minute Enablement Strategy Deep Dive (Sales Leadership, CRO, EBP)
  • 30-minute Values Interview

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

 

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds. 

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.
